character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After surviving an orbital platform ambush and defeating Commander Vance, Kael escaped into the neon-lit underworld with a classified data drive. Decrypting the coordinates revealed a hidden subterranean facility, but the drive triggered a mysterious neural broadcast confirming Vance answered to a higher authority. Now ambushed by an unknown strike team in the alleyways, Kael must fight his way through the trap to find the true mastermind.
